description: Asks for imaging and operative records.

event.subject: Re: Inquiry about visit
event.body:
Good afternoon,

To evaluate your request we need your imaging reports and the operative report from your last procedure. Please send those records by reply and we will review them.

Best,
Denise Alvarado
Clinical Coordinator

expected.rationale: The coordinator asks for imaging reports and an operative report before reviewing.
expected.quote: we need your imaging reports and the operative report from your last procedure
